Embed a CSV/JSON table of polymer compositions and write fingerprints to a file.

Wraps ``polybert_tools.embed_table``. The input file (``.csv`` or ``.json``)
must contain a PSMILES column. If *weight_column* is given, every row's
embedding is weighted by that column and the output is a single blended
fingerprint; otherwise each row is embedded independently.

result.description:
Embed one or more PSMILES polymer strings into 600-dim fingerprints.

Wraps ``polybert_tools.embed_psmiles`` which loads the ``xushijie/polyBERT``
SentenceTransformer (DeBERTa-v2, mean pooling, hidden size 600) from the
HuggingFace Hub and calls ``model.encode``.

psmiles.description:
a single PSMILES string (e.g. ``"[*]CC[*]"``) or a list of
PSMILES strings.

result.description:
Embed a polymer blend as the fraction-weighted mean of component fingerprints.

Wraps ``polybert_tools.embed_blend`` which embeds each component with the
``xushijie/polyBERT`` SentenceTransformer (600-dim) and averages the
embeddings by the given weight fractions (normalised to sum to 1).

psmiles.description: list of PSMILES strings, one per blend component.

weight_fractions.description:
list of weight fractions (same length as *psmiles*).
Need not sum to 1 — they are normalised.
